description: Generate a slide-deck-quality Gantt timeline: task bars and milestone diamonds laid out across numbered time columns (weeks, sprints, months), with optional labelled section bands that group tasks into phases. Choose it for project plans, roadmaps, launch schedules and anything where WHEN each piece of work happens is the point; use a process diagram instead when only the order of phases matters. Limits: 2–52 columns, up to 100 rows. Set duration 0.25 for a milestone. Infer missing details rather than asking; the user can adjust the chart in the builder through the Edit link. ALWAYS give the user the image link: inline chat images usually cannot be saved, but the link renders the exact chart on demand and can be pasted into a slide or Markdown.

inputSchema.description: A Gantt timeline: rows of task bars and milestones across numbered time columns.

columns.description: Number of time columns across the chart (2–52, default 8).

credit.description: Shows a small "twominutetoolkit.com" credit under the chart, inside the card. Set false to leave it off (for example when the user asks for no branding).

labelsInBars.description: Draw each task's name inside its bar (and beside milestone diamonds). Default true.

palette.description: Hex colours applied in order to items that have no colour of their own. Pass the user's brand colours here when they name them. Default: indigo, sky, emerald, amber, red, gray.

start.description: Number of the first column, so 1 gives "Week 1, Week 2…" (default 1).

tasks.description: Rows in the chart, top to bottom (up to 100). Normally just task bars and milestones, which is all most timelines need. Section bands ({ "type": "section" }) may optionally be inserted to group the tasks below them into labelled phases.

color.description: Hex colour, e.g. "#4f46e5". Optional: tasks without one take the next palette colour; sections default to light grey (#e2e8f0). Section label text switches between dark and white for contrast.

duration.description: Length in columns. 0.25 draws a milestone diamond instead of a bar. Tasks only.

name.description: Task or section label. Long names are truncated to fit.

start.description: 0-based start column; 0 is the first column. Quarter steps work (e.g. 1.5). Tasks only.

type.description: Omit for a normal task bar. "section" draws a full-width labelled divider band (start and duration are ignored).

title.description: Heading shown top-left of the chart at 22px bold. Every chart has one title row; an empty string hides it.

unit.description: Column unit label, e.g. "Week", "Sprint", "Month", "Day", "Q". Headers read "<unit> <number>". Default "Week".

width.description: Chart width in pixels (640–2400, default 1280, which suits a 16:9 slide). PNG output renders at 2x. Height is computed from the content.
